children.value: mā gṛhāṇa bhramo hyeṣa śarīramiti jṛmbhate
prāptavānasi rūpaṃ svaṃ viśoko bhava bhūtaye
ayaṃ so'hamidaṃ tanma iti te māstu vibhramaḥ
ātmaivedaṃ tathā sarvaṃ na bhūtoyādikaṃ pṛthak
ayaṃ so'hamiti prājña kva karoṣi vyavasthitim
kiṃ tattvaṃ kiṃ ca vā te syātkiṃ tattvaṃ kiṃ ca vā na te
na dvitvamasti no dehāḥ saṃbandho na ca taiḥ sthitaḥ

paramārthatastu dvitvameva nāstīti tadadhīnā
dehatatsaṃbandhatadupādānakalaṅkādisaṃbhāvanā dūranirastetyāha - neti

nanvātmasaṃbandhābhāve dehasya spandādiḥ kathaṃ mṛtadehe tadadarśanāditi
cettatrāha - spandamiti

tathāca spande
prāṇo balaṃ vā heturnātmetyarthaḥ
siddhe dvitve'pi dehasya na saṃbandhasya saṃbhavaḥ

evaṃ dvaitasatyatvābhyupagame yadā na saṃbandhastadā kiṃ vaktavyaṃ
tadanabhyupagame iti prauḍhivādamupasaṃharannāha - siddhe iti
viruddhatvādapi saṃbandhavatsādṛśyamapi nirasituṃ śakyamityāśayenāha yathā śītoṣṇayoraikyaṃ kathāsvapi na dṛśyate
yatra puṣpaṃ tatra gandhasaṃvidaḥ saṃsthitā yathā

evaṃ ca na śuddhātmanaḥ saṃsāritā nāpi dehasya kiṃtvāntarālikasya jīvasyaiveti
siddhamityāśayenāha - evamiti
ata-eva dehanāśe'pi na jīvanāśa ityāha - ādhāreti
ekaparṇarase kṣīṇe raso naiti yathā kṣayam
śarīrasaṃkṣaye dehī na kṣayaṃ yāti kasyacit
cittanāśo hi nāśaḥ syātsa mokṣa iti kathyate
mṛto naṣṭa iti prokto manye tacca mṛṣā hyasat

ityuktavatyatha munau divaso jagāma
sāyaṃtanāya vidhaye'stamino jagāma

snātuṃ sabhā kṛtanamaskaraṇā jagāma
śyāmākṣaye ravikaraiśca sahājagāma
